# MDL013 mdl-exception

A malformed exception clause.

## What it does

Wrong attribute set for the kind, `on` inside a body, missing `on` at top level, an unknown rule id, a malformed `ticket` or `until`, or a `grimble:accept` style directive in a .grmb comment.

## Why it matters

An exception that is malformed cannot be applied, so the finding it was meant to park stays live while the author believes it is handled.

## Remedy

Write `accept RULE on TARGET because="...";` at the top level, with a known rule id, or inside an entity without `on`.

## Examples

### Fires case 1

```grmb expect=fire file=design/model.grmb
grimble = "2";
module m;
node cli : trusted {
}
accept SYS004 because="missing on";
```

### Clean case 2

```grmb expect=clean file=design/model.grmb
grimble = "2";
module m;
node cli : trusted {
}
accept SYS004 on cli because="one-way import by design";
```
